test_budget.rule: One test pass for the v3 system. Calibrator, policy, answerability threshold, and flag threshold are frozen on val first. No iteration on test; a bug-forced rerun is logged as an extra pass.

labels.policy: v3 does not use the 274 taxonomy labels for fitting or gates. They remain 37 human + 237 LLM-proposed silver labels; any human audit is optional and non-gating.
labels.note: The v2 audit is assistant-estimated, not human. Do not claim human-validated labels.

calibration.base_model: v1 hybrid, frozen C=1.0, fitted on train
calibration.selection: lowest out-of-fold Brier among methods with ECE <= 0.05
calibration.stop_rule: If no calibrator has strictly lower out-of-fold Brier than uncalibrated on val, stop before the test pass and record a negative result.

answerability.features: 30 cached serving features + 3 calibrated class probabilities
answerability.policy: abstain if P(answerable) < tau_a; otherwise answer argmax if its calibrated probability clears the frozen class threshold
answerability.selection: choose tau_a on val to maximise coverage subject to all constraints; scan 0.05..0.95 step 0.01

fallback.trigger: no tau_a meets all constraints on val
fallback.rule: keep verifiable precision/coverage constraints, choose the tau_a that minimises NEI coverage, report the resulting overall precision/coverage, and do not claim an NEI improvement

coverage_flag.target: strict retrieval failure: no complete gold evidence set in top-5
coverage_flag.threshold: same bootstrap lower-bound rule as v2: highest flag rate with 5th-percentile error enrichment >= 2.0, flag rate in [0.05, 0.25]
coverage_flag.fallback: If val AUROC < 0.75, mark the flag omitted before the test pass and do not gate promotion on it.

promotion_gates.brier_max: less than or equal to uncalibrated Brier on the same test rows
promotion_gates.coverage_flag: passes its test gate or is explicitly omitted

notes: v2 artifacts are read-only; all new outputs live under experiments/v3/.
The verdict path is the frozen v1 hybrid; v3 changes confidence, abstention, and the optional warning, not the argmax model.
The answerability model is the v3 addition; if it cannot improve NEI coverage on val, the fallback applies before test.
The coverage flag is optional for promotion; a failure to reach 0.75 AUROC on val removes it from the test system.
No test data is read during P1-P3.
